blocks.caption: Halogenoalkanes banane ke tareeqe
rows: Alkene par hydrogen halide ka addition
kamre ke darja hararat par electrophilic addition
pyridine; zimni products gases hain jo nikal jati, khalis product bachta
3CH3CH2OH + PBr3 -> 3CH3CH2Br + H3PO3; CH3CH2OH + PCl5 -> CH3CH2Cl + POCl3 + HCl
CH3CH2OH + KBr + H2SO4 -> CH3CH2Br + H2O + KHSO4
tezaab aur KBr flask mein HBr banate

blocks.text: KBr wala tareeqa bromoalkanes aur iodoalkanes ke liye aam hai: tezaab pehle potassium halide se react kar ke hydrogen halide deta, jo phir alcohol se react karta hai. Iodoalkanes ke liye phosphoric acid behtar hai kyunke garhe sulphuric acid ke baraks yeh iodide ions ko iodine mein oxidise nahi karta.

blocks.alt: CH3CH2-X ke gird chhe dabbe, har aik se us tak teer: ethane + Cl2 roshni mein; ethene + HBr; ethanol + HCl ZnCl2 ke saath; ethanol + SOCl2 pyridine ke saath; ethanol + PBr3 ya PCl5 (mua'adlat ke saath); ethanol + KBr + H2SO4, iodoalkanes ke liye H3PO4.
blocks.caption: Halogenoethane banane ke chhe tareeqe (kitab ke tareeqon ka asal khulasa).
blocks.long_description: Aik raasta alkane se, aik alkene se aur chaar alcohol se shuru hote hain. Alcohol wale sab raaste -OH group ki jagah halogen lagate hain, hydrogen halide, thionyl chloride, phosphorus halide, ya flask mein bane hydrogen halide se.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Kuch samandari algae aur phytoplankton, jaise Trichodesmium, samandari paani ke bromide ko urne wale organobromine compounds mein badalte hain. Yeh fiza mein pohanch kar bromine ke aalmi chakkar mein hissa lete aur stratosphere ki ozone ghatane mein kirdar ada karte hain. (Kitab bromoethane ka naam leti hai; aam taur par bayan hone wala compound bromomethane hai.)

blocks.prompt: Methanol ko chloromethane mein badalne ke do tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: CH3OH + HCl (ZnCl2 catalyst) -> CH3Cl + H2O; CH3OH + SOCl2 (pyridine) -> CH3Cl + SO2 + HCl; CH3OH + PCl5 -> CH3Cl + POCl3 + HCl.

blocks.prompt: Propan-1-ol ke SOCl2 aur PBr3 se reactions batayein.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2CH2OH + SOCl2 -> CH3CH2CH2Cl + SO2 + HCl; 3CH3CH2CH2OH + PBr3 -> 3CH3CH2CH2Br + H3PO3.

blocks.prompt: Kya methane aur fluorine gas se fluoromethane banaya ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Amalan nahi: fluorine methane se dhamake ke saath react karti hai, qabu shuda monosubstitution ke bajaye fluorinated products, carbon aur HF ka mixture banta hai.

items: Alkanes (X2, roshni), alkenes (HX) ya alcohols (HCl/ZnCl2, SOCl2, PX3, PCl5, KBr + tezaab) se.
SOCl2 ke zimni products gases; iodoalkanes ke liye H3PO4.
